en: The image is a black-and-white postcard showing a Renaissance-style courtyard with arched loggias on two levels, columns with elaborate capitals, a staircase rising along the right wall, and a prominent well in the center. The walls and arches are decorated with a variety of stone coats of arms and plaques, which is a notable feature. No visible contemporary elements or modern text can be spotted.
